classification: custom-aligned research extension; not an official ReCogDrive reward and not a Bench2Drive PDMS
activation_status: inactive; reward semantics are fixed, but the B2D pseudo-simulation cache builder and GRPO adapter are not yet wired

candidate_rollout.ego_dynamics: deployment-consistent PID plus kinematic bicycle rollout
candidate_rollout.other_agents: replay recorded future boxes and interpolate the 10 Hz annotations to rollout frequency
candidate_rollout.map: Bench2Drive HD map plus scenario-aware permitted route corridor
candidate_rollout.important_limitation: recorded actors are non-reactive; all offline components must be validated against held-out closed-loop B2D outcomes

safety.note: TTC is a B2D training proxy supported by B2D log-replay work, not an official B2D report column

compliance.route_rule: never use unconditional lane-center distance; permitted corridors must include scenario-valid merge, overtake and detour behavior
compliance.scenario_task: derive a local ability-aware signal for merge, overtake, emergency brake, give way or traffic-sign behavior; report official Multi-Ability only from closed-loop route success

efficiency.progress_score: clip(candidate_route_progress / reference_route_progress, 0, 1); stationary expert windows pass only when the candidate is also stationary within 0.5 m
efficiency.note: speed_score is the local, capped counterpart of official B2D Driving Efficiency; raw uncapped percentages remain diagnostics

comfort.reporting_rule: only official_segment_pass_ratio may be compared with B2D Driving Smoothness; the margin term is training-only

requirements: no B2D infraction that would invalidate route success
hard_feasibility.reason: retain graded safety and task signals while ensuring an unsafe or illegal candidate cannot outrank a feasible one

official_infraction_penalty.minimum_speed: excluded from Driving Score in B2D V0.0.3

plain_grpo_scalar_baseline.purpose: compatibility and ablation only; this is not the future Pareto optimizer
plain_grpo_scalar_baseline.ordering_invariant: every feasible candidate outranks every infeasible candidate

imitation_anchor.implementation: retain the frozen Stage2 reference policy through the existing KL/BC term
imitation_anchor.reason: expert ADE is useful for stability but making it a Pareto objective would suppress valid multimodal overtake, merge and detour solutions

validation_gates_before_training: unit and synthetic counterexample tests pass
all four objectives have non-zero within-group variance on held-out training clips
collision and rule violations are detected with >= 0.99 recall on injected counterexamples
component signs and rank correlations are reported on a held-out split rather than assumed
no official 220-route result is used to tune thresholds or scalar weights
reward definition, cache commit, controller and evaluator commit are frozen before final 220-route evaluation
